name: Pat Wilson
office: City of Rolling Hills, Member of the City Council

items.text: Patrick Wilson is an incumbent member of the Rolling Hills City Council and a business owner. He was first elected to the council in 2015. Wilson says public safety is his top concern, including protection from wildfires, home burglaries, and land movement. He says he has served on the city’s Traffic Commission for nearly 20 years and on regional public safety and law committees for over a decade.
